$description: The scale is the Figma spacing variable set. Steps are named by their pixel value because that is how the design file names them.

0.description: Figma spacing/0. Icon variants set gap to zero and let padding do the work.

2.description: Figma spacing/2. The only step under 4. It holds the text off the top and bottom of its own box inside a banner.

4.description: Figma spacing/4. Bottom padding on a tag. The uppercase label sits high in its box, so the bottom is tighter than the top.

6.description: Figma spacing/6. Top padding on a tag. Gap between a field unit and its chevron.

8.description: Figma spacing/8. Horizontal padding on a tag. Gap between a small link and its arrow.

10.description: Figma spacing/10. Vertical padding on a 38px control and on a field. Nav gap. Gap between a field label and its box.

12.description: Figma spacing/12. Gap between label and icon. Nav vertical padding. Trailing padding beside an icon. Horizontal padding inside a field.

20.description: Figma spacing/20. Horizontal padding on every non-nav button.

24.description: Figma spacing/24. The gap between an accordion's open heading and its paragraph.

32.description: Figma spacing/32. Padding inside an accordion at desktop width. The gap between tabs on a work index, where the row is the whole page width.

40.description: Figma spacing/40. The gap between an accordion's header row and its description at mobile width.

48.description: Figma spacing/48. The gap between the choices and the payment block inside a donate modal.

64.description: Figma spacing/64. The gap between an accordion's header row and its description at desktop width.

72.description: Figma content/2xlarge. The widest rhythm between children placed in a section.

120.description: Figma spacing/120. The gap between an editorial carousel's section head and its track at desktop width.

148.description: Figma section/horz. Inline padding on a section at desktop width.

200.description: Figma section/vert-large. Block padding on a section at desktop width when padding is large.
